title: Reading a Clock Using Fractions
description: What 'quarter past' actually means — a clock-face visual connecting time-telling to fractions.
narration_lines: What does 'quarter past' actually mean on a clock?
Here's a clock showing 3:15, the hands pointing at 3 and 15 minutes.
15 minutes is 15 out of 60 total minutes in an hour.
That's exactly 1 quarter. Quarter past means a quarter of the way around.

params.footnote: quarter past = 1/4 of the way around the clock
